open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmation version binding
open_points.text: the revision or access version if the step showed one
open_points.question: For each confirmation-producing action, when does its confirmation step show and bind a revision or access version, and specifically must an archive confirmation bind the Project revision on which it was shown?
options: Every confirmation for a revisioned or access-versioned target stores the version used to render the step, whether or not visibly displayed.
Only confirmation steps that visibly present a version store it; other confirmations remain unversioned.
A specified action-by-action set of confirmation steps stores a revision or access version, while the rest do not.
open_points.default_guess: Bind the current Project revision whenever a project confirmation step is created, and bind an access version whenever a session-access confirmation step is created.

witness.initial: Active project P is at revision 7; the owner has two signed-in OwnerSessions.
events: In OwnerSession A, the owner opens the confirmation step to archive P while P is at revision 7.
In OwnerSession B, the owner corrects P, moving it to revision 8.
In OwnerSession A, the owner submits the pending archive confirmation.
outcomes: If the confirmation step showed and stored revision 7, the archive is refused as stale and P remains active at revision 8.
If the step did not show or store a revision, an implementer can treat the confirmation as unversioned and archive P at revision 8.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a stale-change refusal or a successfully archived project.
